# Whisperbox

> Ask a question, share the link, and read anonymous answers as they arrive. Free, with no app and no sign-up.

- [Home](https://getwhisperbox.vercel.app/): ask a question and get a share link
- [Question ideas](https://getwhisperbox.vercel.app/ideas): 44 anonymous question ideas for friends, crushes, groups and feedback
- [Privacy](https://getwhisperbox.vercel.app/privacy): what is stored (answers keep only text and time)
- [Terms](https://getwhisperbox.vercel.app/terms)
- [Source code](https://github.com/Shahryartariq/whisperbox)
